notes.title: Chorus of Carcosa - Minor Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for playing Chorus of Carcosa! We’re constantly reviewing your feedback and working hard to improve the game.

In this update, we’ve fixed an issue:
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem where, on certain specific machine configurations, instead of in-game videos, a never-ending black screen would appear.  This situation most often occurred on a looped staircase with anomalies.
[/list]
If you encounter any bugs or want to share your feedback, [url=https://discord.com/invite/b7ZjxM5FGb]join our Discord[/url] or write in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2987750/discussions/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam Discussions[/url].

Thanks for playing,
Chameleon 42

notes.title: Chorus of Carcosa - Extended Ending Fix Patch
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Following the major Extended Ending Update, here are a couple more important fixes to enhance your gameplay experience.

[list]
[*]We’ve integrated and configured a tool for sending us crash logs
[*]Puzzle with lockers in the kindergarten - in some cases, specific lockers did not affect the solution of the puzzle
[*]Puzzle with tiles in the flashback of the Composer - added a little detail to make the puzzle visually clearer to resolve
[*]Fixed a bug with the radio at low FPS (it could duplicate or disappear)
[*]Fixed the "flickering" of debris when the statue breaks the wall in the basement
[*]Fixed an issue in the powder scattering scene (the Сomposer’s flashback) where the first interaction point sometimes wouldn’t trigger right away
[/list]

If you encounter any bugs or want to share your feedback, [url=https://discord.com/invite/b7ZjxM5FGb]join our Discord[/url] or write in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2987750/discussions/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam Discussions[/url].

Thanks for playing,
Chameleon 42

notes.title: Chorus of Carcosa - Extended Ending Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We continue to work on improving your experience in Chorus of Carcosa, and today we’d like to share a new update with you.

[b]Today's update focuses on:[/b]

[list]
[*] Extended ending – [i]there's still something here that awaits you...[/i]
[*] Achievement bug fix – we've fixed the issue with cumulative achievements. New players should no longer face this issue. However, for those who already encountered this bug, progress will need to be restarted, as we couldn’t find a way to recover broken achievements. 
[/list]
We appreciate your patience and dedication to uncovering the mysteries of Carcosa. Stay tuned for more updates!

If you encounter any bugs or want to share your feedback - feel free to [url=https://discord.com/invite/b7ZjxM5FGb]join our Discord[/url] or write in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2987750/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].

notes.title: Chorus of Carcosa - Movement & Stamina Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The first weekend for Chorus of Carcosa was huge, and we’ve gathered a ton of valuable feedback.
Thanks to all our players! We’re actively working on the game, and today, we’ve got a big update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039697/c507964a589ab01eca386287f58ced77c852fb24.jpg[/img]

[b]Today's update focuses on the following issues:[/b]

[list]
[*] Full character movement rebalance: the character now walks and crawls faster, and can run for a longer duration
[*] Stamina and breath indicators are now displayed on the screen. It will disappear when indicators are full to avoid unnecessary clutter
[*] Added more shortcuts in The Winter Garden to make dodging the monster easier
[*] The screen darkening during breath-holding will no longer obstruct visibility
[*] Fixed a fatality bug that occasionally caused the scene to be viewed from the side
[*] Added a prompt about crouching during the first monster encounter
[*] Updated button visuals for skipping the credits
[*] Added some visual hints for star map and musical staff puzzles
[*] And a batch of minor fixes 
[/list]
[i][b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b][/i] you can encounter a bug - when you die with this stat on the screen, it will break until the next level is loaded. 
We are already working on fixing this bug.

We're carefully reading all the comments about your experience. So if you encounter any bugs or want to share your feedback - feel free to [url=https://discord.com/invite/b7ZjxM5FGb]join our Discord[/url] or write in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2987750/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].

You can also follow us on:
🟡[url=https://x.com/ChorusOfCarcosa]X/Twitter[/url]
🟡[url=https://bsky.app/profile/chorus-of-carcosa.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
🟡[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@chorusofcarcosa_]TikTok[/url]

Thanks for playing and commenting,
Chameleon 42

notes.title: Chorus of Carcosa - A small QoL update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[b]Thank you for playing Chorus of Carcosa![/b] We’re actively gathering feedback across our social media and community channels - and, of course, keeping a close eye on any emerging bugs.
[b]
Today's patch focuses on the following issues:[/b]

[list]
[*] Graphics settings now display correctly on first launch
[*] The game now adapts to the primary monitor’s resolution on first launch
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could fail to load properly after dying in the kindergarten
[*] And many minor fixes to improve overall game stability.
[/list]

We truly appreciate all of you for sharing your feedback with us. The weekend is almost here - perfect for diving deeper into the world of Carcosa.

If you encounter any bugs or want to share your feedback, join [url=https://discord.com/invite/b7ZjxM5FGb]our Discord[/url] or write in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2987750/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].
